Thank you that you sent your Son, Jesus, to die on the cross 
for me so that I could be forgiven and set free. From now on 
I will follow and obey him as my Lord.
Thank you that you now offer me this gift of forgiveness and 
your Spirit. I now receive that gift.
Please come into my life by your Holy Spirit to be with me for 
ever. Through Jesus Christ, our Lord. Amen.
